stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Two lines for the same invites?

stations.title: Order screen
stations.text: Four copies of the code that adds a line.
stations.note: And no word while it waits.

stations.title: Idris's books
stations.text: One line per item, and a total that waits.

captions: Idris finds an invoice with two lines for the same invites, and asks why.
The code that adds to the basket was written four times, four ways.
You give every change a name beside the state, and one that waits, in three tasks.
Now ordering invites again adds to their line, and the total says when it waits.
Every change to the order has one name and one home, written once.
